prompt: Open the environments list and find the three course environments.
expected_answer: HLE-Dev: type Developer, Dataverse yes. HLE-Test: type Sandbox, Dataverse yes. HLE-Prod: type Production, Dataverse yes. All three in the same region.
expected_source: admin:Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments

prompt: Open each of HLE-Test and HLE-Prod and check the Managed Environments status; then open HLE-Dev and try to assign a security group.
expected_answer: HLE-Test and HLE-Prod show Managed Environments enabled. HLE-Dev is not managed and offers no security group assignment (developer environments are owner-only).
expected_source: admin:Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > (environment)

prompt: In HLE-Dev open the solution HLEHarbourlineOps and list its components.
expected_answer: Unmanaged solution HLEHarbourlineOps, publisher hleharbourline (prefix hle), version 1.0.1.0 or higher. Contains tables hle_Asset, hle_Crew, hle_WorkOrder and relationships hle_Asset_WorkOrder and hle_Crew_WorkOrder; agent HLE Field Ops Assistant; agent flows HLE Get Outage Status and HLE Dispatch Crew; custom connector HLE Outage API; at least one connection reference; environment variable hle_OutageApiBaseUrl with no current value in the solution.

prompt: Check the deployed solution in HLE-Test and HLE-Prod (Solutions list, or pac solution list --environment <url> on the fallback path).
expected_answer: HLEHarbourlineOps is present in both targets as Managed, with the same version as the last deployment from HLE-Dev. No unmanaged solution named HLEHarbourlineOps exists in either target.
expected_source: admin:Power Apps (make.powerapps.com) > HLE-Test and HLE-Prod > Solutions

prompt: Open the pipeline run history for HLEHarbourlineOps, then the admin deployment page.
expected_answer: HLE Ops Pipeline has stages Test (target HLE-Test) and Prod (target HLE-Prod); both runs show Deployment succeeded for the same artifact version. The admin deployment page shows both targets as managed and no notification about deployments to non-managed targets.

prompt: In HLE-Test open HLEHarbourlineOps, select HLE Field Ops Assistant and HLE Get Outage Status, and view their solution layers.
expected_answer: Each component shows only the HLEHarbourlineOps managed layer (plus system layers). No Active (unmanaged) layer on top.
expected_source: admin:Power Apps (make.powerapps.com) > HLE-Test > Solutions > HLEHarbourlineOps > See solution layers

prompt: In HLE-Prod open the environment variable HLE Outage API Base URL (hle_OutageApiBaseUrl) and the connection reference for HLE Outage API.
expected_answer: The environment variable value in HLE-Prod is the production API base URL you supplied at deployment (not a devtunnels.ms URL). The connection reference is bound to a connection that exists in HLE-Prod, and both agent flows are On.
expected_source: admin:Power Apps (make.powerapps.com) > HLE-Prod > Solutions > HLEHarbourlineOps > Environment variables

prompt: Open the environment routing setting and read its state and rules.
expected_answer: The Environment routing setting is visible under Tenant settings. You can state whether it is on, which portals it covers, and which rule (if any) routes makers, and you can explain that with no matching rule makers go to the default environment.
expected_source: admin:Power Platform admin center > Manage > Tenant settings > Environment routing

prompt: Open the Microsoft 365 agent settings and read User access and Sharing.
expected_answer: User access is set to specific users and groups including <Prefix>-AllStaff (options are All users, No users, or specific users and groups). The Sharing setting is present and applies only to agents built in Agent Builder.

prompt: After publishing HLE Field Ops Assistant from HLE-Prod to Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot, open the agent requests list; approve it; then sign in as Priya Nandakumar and check the Agent Store.
expected_answer: Before approval: HLE Field Ops Assistant is listed with state Pending review. After Publish to store scoped to <Prefix>-AllStaff: it leaves the Requests list, appears in the All agents inventory as Published by your org, and Priya sees it under Built by your org.
expected_source: admin:Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > All agents > Requests

prompt: Run solutions/lab-11/Get-HleAgentInventory.ps1 -Prefix HLE (and again with -PendingOnly while a request is open).
expected_answer: The script lists course agents from GET /beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages with displayName, platform (Copilot Studio or Microsoft 365 Copilot Agent Builder), isBlocked false, availableTo and deployedTo. With -PendingOnly it returns the open requests with requestStatus pending and requestType publish or update. Record the output: this API is preview.
